verdict.rationale: The evidence covers invoice status notifications (viewed, due, paid), overdue reminders, and general reports such as the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow. None of it documents an accounts receivable aging report or per-customer balance tracking. Invoice status alerts and reminders are adjacent features, not the AR aging and customer-balance capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can track accounts receivable with aging reports and per-customer balances
